items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: That’s a good one. That’s really good.

ctx.x: Yes exactly. Just forcing myself just to come from different places and that’s actually kind of been fruitful. I found a couple of — not full songs yet — but things that feel different. And it might also be something — I’ll be watching a movie or a TV show and just hear a groove that wouldn’t be something that I would normally start with and you just kind of do a little bit of — I don’t know whose quote this is but they say, “In literature it’s plagiarism but in music it’s influence.”

I think I can remember this — Pepper Adams — Jerry Dodgion told me this story of Pepper Adams, they were in front of a whole group of students and you know they were talking about influences and so forth, and Pepper said, “If you take from one person it’s plagiarism, if you take from everybody it’s research.”
That’s a good one. That’s really good.
